Plugin.Name: Fejes Mover Monitor
Plugin.Overview: Hungarian-language Mover activity dashboard and open-file monitor for Unraid 7.x. Requires a pool named cache. Shows process status, cache usage and recent Mover log lines without starting Mover. Includes an optional settings panel for an existing Filmek_Mover_Threshold script; no automation script or schedule is installed. Early public release: custom pool names, transfer ETA and English translation are not supported.
